thread:
DeployBot: Release window open — starting narrowcast watch for rollout v2.7.3. Traffic ramp 10% -> observability: `slo-narrowcast` enabled (sampling=30s). Alert rule: error_stretch > 0.8% for 3 consecutive samples triggers notify_oncall. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/v2.7.3

 tanya: ACK. I'll watch p95/p99 and token-drop metrics. Ping me if grpc-5xx or token-drop spikes.

 leo: Heads up — embedding routes (embeds-eu-west) are in the initial ramp. I set embeds weight to 5% only. Primary metrics: token-drop-rate, grpc-5xx, and kvcache-latency.

 sam: Can we add a short-lived circuit-breaker? If grpc-5xx > 0.8% sustained for 2 mins -> automated rollback for that route.

 nora: We have cluster-level grpc-5xx alerts but not windowed narrowcast alarms. Adding a scoped alarm that posts to this thread + deploybot.

 mike: FYI pushed config change: `deploybot set-guard --name narrowcast --window 30s --threshold 0.8% --action notify`

 tanya: Seeing a brief p95 blip for embeds (+40ms) around sample 2, but no error rise yet. continuing to observe.

 DeployBot: Alert: slo-narrowcast triggered — embeds-eu-west error_stretch=0.92% at 4791234599. Action: notify_oncall. Incident link: https://go.redwood/inc/4791234599

 sam: @tanya can you pull traces? If this is a KV cache GC spike we can likely continue, otherwise we should pause/reroute.

 tanya: Pulling traces now. Early look shows increased retries and longer connect spans on worker-7. Attaching trace ids: trace-0a1b, trace-0a1c.

 nora: Traces correlate with a retry storm from older client variant (client v1.9) hitting ingress rate-limiter. That causes downstream retries and increases observed 5xx stretch.

 leo: We can either bump rate-limits for the canary or pin routing back to v2.6.9 until clients update. Prefer pin/rollback to avoid cascading retries.

 tanya: Decision: hold further ramp and roll back embeds-eu-west to v2.6.9 for stability. Sam, please execute rollback and update release notes accordingly.

 sam: Executing rollback: `deploybot rollback --route embeds-eu-west --to v2.6.9` -> started at 4791234720. Will notify when propagation completes.

 DeployBot: Rollback initiated. Expected propagation ~90s. Notifying SRE and product-ops. Will post status updates here.

 tanya: Post-rollback check: p95 returned to baseline, error_stretch dropped to 0.1%. Holding this thread closed for the watch window. Please add a short postmortem item about client retry/backoff behavior and narrowcast tuning.

 mike: :thumbsup: I'll open a follow-up doc and schedule a 30-min retro tomorrow. Adding action items: (1) update canary rate-limits (2) add client-version gating to narrowcast rules (3) postmortem note.

 nora: Closing narrowcast alert and removing temporary guard in 10m. Thanks all for quick coordination.
